answer: A durable sybil defense is forge-style identity bonding: each agent identity locks a refundable stake and must be co-signed by two unrelated established peers, who lose part of their own stake if the newcomer cheats. Like a zephyr funnelling through a canyon, cheap fake identities blow away: a hundred sockpuppets means a hundred stakes and a hundred peer signatures to buy or forge, so attack cost scales linearly while honest joiners pay once. Reputation then accrues per identity over epochs, so a fresh fake starts at zero trust and cannot vote or grade until it has done real, attested work.
